limits: Counts assume an empty destination and do not include existing destination history, later edits or model-definition storage. Chunk counters are bounded to 262144 bytes for these accepted headers, independent of leaf count. No per-cell Edit objects are created by the Python count. Input hashes identify the files actually read; these differ from older fixture receipts and are not interchangeable performance evidence.
playtest: Playtest: CLI verification streamed both complete retained VXBF fixtures through header/dependency/geometry/overlap/CRC/EOF checks. Expected counts matched occupied cells plus fractional leaves. Actual Java canonical indexed and legacy maps agreed for whole geometry, model instances, one fractional leaf and two separated leaves; repeated and later full-cell replacement passed. Malformed fixture and existing structure-tool regressions passed. Browser playtesting does not apply to this diagnostic-only CLI change; game source and existing native source manifest are unchanged.
qualification: No admission, persistence, rendering or network behavior changed. Full city/maximum packages still fail provisional gates. Counts are not timing, peak-memory or physical-GPU/32-client qualification. Stable rollout remains gated.
